data.title: Contribution notice for voluntary health insurance from 1 June 2026
data.summary: Allgemeine Musterkasse sets your voluntary health and long-term care insurance contributions at €530.85 per month from 1 June 2026. The contributions are collected by direct debit on the 15th of the following month.
data.explanation: Your health insurer has confirmed your contributions as a voluntary member: €412.65 for health insurance and €118.20 for long-term care insurance, €530.85 in total per month. The money is taken automatically by direct debit on the 15th of the following month, so make sure your account has enough funds. If you think the amount is wrong, you may file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing, electronically or in person. The deadline is one month from notification, and the app shows the exact date. Consider getting advice if you are unsure about your income assessment.
data.tax_note: Health and long-term care insurance contributions can be deductible as special expenses (Sonderausgaben) in your tax return.
